key_insight: Adding one scalar coordinate lifts a convex domain to a cone, unifying several learning-rate-free optimization algorithms through a shared regret analysis.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a principled route to online and stochastic convex optimizers without user-tuned learning rates, including for unbounded domains.
method: Lift decisions to a cone and construct orthogonal lifted subgradients.
Apply Follow-the-Regularized-Leader or Online Mirror Descent on the cone.
Optimize the comparator scale in the regret analysis to obtain parameter-free guarantees.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical regret guarantees and exact recovery of CBA, CBA+ and unconstrained Hilbert-space KT coin-betting, but no empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: Guarantees depend on domain geometry and gradient assumptions; the no-gradient-bound result is specifically for unconstrained domains.
